item.title: Karuizawa: Nagano's Fashionable Highland Resort Town — Guide
item.description: Karuizawa is a fashionable highland resort town in eastern Nagano, long favoured since the late 19th century as a cool summer retreat from the heat of Tokyo, and now easily reached by Shinkansen in around an hour. The town combines refreshing forested scenery and cycling paths with an upmarket resort atmosphere of cafes, restaurants, historic churches and a large outlet shopping mall by the station, making it a relaxed and accessible destination that blends nature, leisure and shopping across the seasons.
